#### Libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
library("readxl")
library("rdryad")
```

#### Getting the data

After some attempts at downloading the found data programmatically via the `rdryad` package, which all have failed, we have resorted to manually uploading the data files to the `_raw` folder, from which we then import the excel files using `read_excel`.

```{r}
#url_1 <- "https://datadryad.org/downloads/file_stream/248659"
#dest_file_1 <- file.path(data_path, "tpc119453_Supplemental_Data_Set_1.xlsx")

Sys.setenv(DRYAD_API_TOKEN = "11EUwxIno8Baj36be8l496pgZbFotVXWgrrbcYo_-5g")

my_doi <- "10.5061/dryad.4f7n5"
#downloaded_files <- dryad_download(dois = my_doi)
# 2. Extract the dataset metadata to find individual file IDs
meta <- dryad_dataset(dois = my_doi)

# 3. Pull out the specific numeric file IDs from the metadata
# (This extracts the IDs for all files attached to this specific dataset)
file_ids <- meta[[1]]$links$`stash:files`

# 4. Download each file one by one via its distinct ID
# You can specify a local directory path if you want to save them outside your cache
downloaded_paths <- dryad_files_download(ids = file_ids)

# View where your files successfully saved on your network drive
print(downloaded_paths)
```

#### Example of loading local file into .xlsx

```{r}
tpc119453_Supplemental_Data_Set_5 <- read_excel(
  "~/Projects/group_13_exam_project/data/_raw/tpc119453_Supplemental+Data+Set+5.xlsx",
  sheet = "DataSet5A", skip = 6)

```
